name: Pest Lead Agent · Alert on errors

parameters.content:
## Pest Lead Agent: alert on errors

Set as `settings.errorWorkflow` on "Pest Lead Agent · Book new lead" and "Pest Lead Agent · Handle approval". It first gives the failed run's claim (a lead, or an approval decision) back to the event ledger (marked failed), so the sender's redelivery or the approver's next click is processed again, then posts a short, personal-data-free alert (with the event id) to Slack #automation-alerts and appends a row to the Errors tab of the log sheet. If the ledger itself is down the claim goes stale after 10 minutes.
Release the event claim, describe the failure, tell Slack, write the Errors row. All three calls are non-critical.

nodes.name: Receive error
nodes.notes: Runs when the Book new lead or the Handle approval workflow fails.

nodes.name: Describe failure
nodes.notes: Reads the failed execution id from the error trigger.

nodes.name: Release failed event
nodes.notes: Hands the failed run's claim (a lead or an approval decision) back to the ledger, marked failed, so a retry is processed again.

nodes.name: Compose alert
nodes.notes: Short alert text: workflow, failed node, event id, error message. No customer data.

nodes.name: Append error log row
nodes.notes: Appends to the Errors tab of the log sheet. Non-critical.
